# Web routes in the right group

`W18` · Coding rule

New web routes inside the right group: /hq (Admin), /manager (manager.only), / (auth + role); nothing new in the unauthenticated top section without approval; CSRF on POST

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-web|Web app coding rules]].
